name: Hare's-foot Clover
desc: Hare's-foot Clover (Trifolium arvense): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 10 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Trifolium arvense, commonly known as the hare's-foot clover, rabbitfoot clover, stone clover or oldfield clover, is a flowering plant in the bean family, Fabaceae. It is native to Europe.
